# Atlas (2024 film) – Summary
**Atlas (2024 film)** is a science fiction action film released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, starring Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, alongside Simu Liu, Sterling K. Brown, Gregory James Cohan (voice of Smith), Abraham Popoola, Lana Parrilla, and Mark Strong. Atlas depicts the journey of a distrustful AI analyst as she fights to stop Harlan, a rogue artificial intelligence terrorist, from destroying humanity. After joining a military mission to the Andromeda Galaxy, Atlas is forced to work with Smith, an AI-powered mecha suit (ARC), confronting her past guilt and gradually developing a bond with Smith. The climax revolves around Atlas's battle with Harlan and highlights themes of human-AI interaction, guilt, redemption, and the ambiguous nature of artificial intelligence.
**Production and Reception:** Written by Leo Sardarian and rewritten by Aron Eli Coleite, Atlas was filmed in Los Angeles and New Zealand between August and November 2022. Upon Netflix release, Atlas quickly topped global charts, reaching number one in 71 countries with 60 million views by June 2024 and a high viewer completion rate of 80%. Despite commercial popularity, critics gave negative reviews: Rotten Tomatoes scored it 19% and Metacritic 37/100, criticizing the script despite praising Lopez's performance. The film garnered nominations for the Golden Reel Awards and a Golden Raspberry (Worst Actress for Lopez).
